newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: No buyers seen for Colombian June coffee.
newsitem.headline: No buyers seen for Colombian June coffee.

text.p: Private exporters said they were having a hard time finding buyers for about 300,000 60-kg bags of Colombian green coffee for shipment in June because the beans had essentially been priced out of the market.
Earlier this month, National Coffee Growers' Federation reopened May/June coffee registrations for shipment of a maximum of 500,000 60-kg bags by private exporters to Europe and Japan.
But exporters were authorized to sell the same coffee to the United States and Canada Thursday, because only about 150,000 to 200,000 bags had been sold in Europe and Japan.
There have been no takers for the remaining coffee in North America either, however, since it is priced against the expensive July contract.
"The spread between July and September is just too big," one exporter said. "No one is going to want to buy at these prices."

"September is a lot cheaper," added another exporter, who said the Federation would ultimately have to allow the price to be set over the September futures contract in New York because "they're just aren't going to be any buyers at these levels."
